initial.name: vehicles.new.initial
initial.purpose: Volledige voertuigselectie voor een initiële load
initial.sql: SELECT vehicle, CHASSIS, PROGRESS, FRAN as LETTER, DESC002 as [DESC_], REGN, exec001, SELLLOCN, BUYLOCN, NAME_, INAME, RECDATEE, RECDATE, {DELIVERY_DATE} FROM vs_00_newvehiclestock WHERE ({DELIVERY_DATE} >= CURDATE() OR PROGRESS = '{SOLD_PROGRESS}')

initial.name: vehicles.used.initial
initial.purpose: Volledige gebruikte voertuigselectie voor een initiële load
initial.sql: SELECT vehicle, CHASSIS, PROGRESS, FRAN as LETTER, DESC002 as [DESC_], REGN, exec001, SELLLOCN, BUYLOCN, NAME_, INAME, SALEDATE, SINVDATE, {DELIVERY_DATE} FROM vs_00_usedvehiclestock WHERE ({DELIVERY_DATE} >= CURDATE() OR PROGRESS = '{SOLD_PROGRESS}')

initial.name: support.brands
initial.sql: SELECT DISTINCT LETTER, DESC002 FROM DD_00_FRANCHISERECORDS

initial.name: support.salespersons
initial.sql: select DISTINCT userid, name_ from gb_00_userdetails

initial.name: support.locations
initial.sql: select code, name_ from gb_00_companylocations where type_ in ('C', 'S')

initial.name: vehicle.new.specifications.initial
initial.purpose: Werkplaatsregels gekoppeld aan de initiële voertuigen
initial.sql: SELECT s.MAGIC, s.VTYPE, s.desc002, s.socomp, s.poshdr, s.orderno, s.coststat FROM vs_00_vehiclespecification s WHERE VTYPE = 'N' and MAGIC in (select vehicle from vs_00_newvehiclestock WHERE ({DELIVERY_DATE} >= CURDATE() OR PROGRESS = '{SOLD_PROGRESS}')) and source = 'W'

initial.name: vehicle.used.specifications.initial
initial.purpose: Werkplaatsregels gekoppeld aan de initiële voertuigen
initial.sql: SELECT s.MAGIC, s.VTYPE, s.desc002, s.socomp, s.poshdr, s.orderno, s.coststat FROM vs_00_vehiclespecification s WHERE VTYPE = 'U' and MAGIC in (select vehicle from vs_00_usedvehiclestock WHERE ({DELIVERY_DATE} >= CURDATE() OR PROGRESS = '{SOLD_PROGRESS}')) and source = 'W'

sync.name: vehicles.new.sync
sync.purpose: Nieuwe voertuigen die volgens de recovery audit opnieuw moeten worden geladen
sync.sql: SELECT vehicle, CHASSIS, PROGRESS, FRAN as LETTER, desc002 as [DESC_], REGN, exec001, SELLLOCN, BUYLOCN, NAME_, INAME, RECDATEE, RECDATE, {DELIVERY_DATE} FROM vs_00_newvehiclestock WHERE ({DELIVERY_DATE} >= CURDATE() OR PROGRESS = '{SOLD_PROGRESS}') AND VEHICLE IN (SELECT DISTINCT VEHICLE FROM VS_00_AUDITRECOVERYLOG WHERE VTYPE = 'N')

sync.name: vehicles.used.sync
sync.purpose: Gebruikte voertuigen die volgens de recovery audit opnieuw moeten worden geladen

sync.name: vehicle.new.specifications.sync
sync.purpose: Specificaties van nieuwe voertuigen die volgens de recovery audit opnieuw moeten worden geladen
sync.sql: SELECT s.MAGIC, s.VTYPE, s.desc002, s.socomp, s.poshdr, s.orderno, s.coststat FROM vs_00_vehiclespecification s WHERE VTYPE = 'N' AND MAGIC IN (SELECT vehicle FROM vs_00_newvehiclestock WHERE ({DELIVERY_DATE} >= CURDATE() OR PROGRESS = '{SOLD_PROGRESS}') AND VEHICLE IN (SELECT DISTINCT VEHICLE FROM VS_00_AUDITRECOVERYLOG WHERE VTYPE = 'N')) AND source = 'W'
